(For he who hates you, he will be cut off.)" As-Suddi said

english_local_transition.scope_limit: This proves a local omission only. It does not establish global absence in every English edition or authorize an invented English sentence.

later_english_preserved_remembrance_cont.exact_text: So they thought in their ignorance that if his sons died, his remembrance would be cut off. Allah forbid! To the contrary, Allah preserved his remembrance for all the world to see, and He obligated all the servants to follow his Law. This will continue for all of time until the Day of Gathering and the coming of the Hereafter.
later_english_preserved_remembrance_cont.distinction: This passage says that Muhammad's remembrance is preserved and his law remains obligatory. It does not translate the Arabic I11 universalization over every person characterized by the hostility previously described.
